dedupe_keys.name: nebula postcode building energy dataset generation code

description: The Cambridge NEBULA team publishes Python scripts for assembling a postcode-level building-energy context dataset. The public GitHub tree contains a main entry point, processing modules, input-source notes and requirements. Its LICENSE explicitly states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, including noncommercial and share-alike conditions, although GitHub summarizes it only as Other. Source is free to view. Coverage follows England and Wales postcode and source-data conventions. The workflow can prepare neighbourhood inputs for building-energy or retrofit simulations in a related tool such as model-energyplus. A caveat is that some source datasets require academic access, and running the code does not grant those upstream rights. The separately archived version 2 CSV output states CC BY 4.0, a different licence. Own GitHub metadata, README and licence were read without executing the pipeline or downloading large inputs. No direct simulator interface was verified.
